newsitem.title: BRAZIL: New York-bound flight forced to return to Rio.
newsitem.headline: New York-bound flight forced to return to Rio.

text.p: A United Airlines flight to New York was forced to return to Rio de Janeiro after take off because of a faulty engine, airline officials said Thursday.

The Boeing 767-300 aircraft with 266 passengers on board was forced to return to Rio de Janeiro's Galeao airport shortly after take off Wednesday night because of one faulty engine, a spokeswoman said.
She said there was no emergency landing and the passengers were rescheduled on the same day flight from Rio de Janeiro to Miami.
